node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 order-two component orientation trichotomy
node.statement: Every actual residual KoalaBear component of type (m,r,delta)=(2,4,2) has an order-two stabilizer in V4. The two coordinate subgroups are equivalent under endpoint transposition, with a fresh source record after transport. The remaining diagonal subgroup splits exhaustively according to whether its action preserves the quadratic source intermediate field: the preserving branch is the reciprocal source-line lift, and the nonpreserving branch is a genus-zero or genus-one biquadratic source cover with the printed V4 passports. This is a component-level classification only; it does not map active bad slopes to components, cover the live trivial-stabilizer (2,8,1) type, delete any orientation, or move a ledger value.
